title: Home Assistant Blueprint
description: Editor validation for Home Assistant blueprints. Derived from homeassistant.components.blueprint.schemas.BLUEPRINT_SCHEMA. This provides completion and typo detection while editing; script/blueprint-check remains authoritative, because it runs Home Assistant's own validator against the pinned version.

blueprint.description: Blueprint metadata shown in the import dialog.

description.description: What the blueprint does, what it requires, and any caveats. Markdown is supported and rendered in the import dialog.

domain.description: The domain this blueprint targets. Must match the folder it lives in (blueprints/<domain>/<author>/).

source_url.description: GitHub blob URL of this file on the default branch. This is what makes re-import and updating work for users; script/blueprint-check verifies it matches the file's actual path.

min_version.description: Oldest supported Home Assistant version, formatted as major.minor.patch (e.g. 2024.10.0). Raise it when adopting newer syntax.

input.description: User-configurable fields, referenced in the blueprint body with the !input tag.

description.description: Help text shown under the field.

default.description: Value used when the user leaves the field untouched. Providing one wherever sensible keeps the blueprint usable with minimal configuration.

section.description: A visual group of inputs. Requires Home Assistant 2024.6.0 or newer.

icon.description: Icon shown next to the section title (e.g. mdi:cog).

description.description: Help text shown under the section title.

collapsed.description: Whether the section starts collapsed. Use for advanced options so the common path stays short.

input.description: Inputs nested in this section. Their keys stay globally unique and are referenced directly with !input.

selector.description: The UI control for this input. Exactly one selector type must be given. See https://www.home-assistant.io/docs/blueprint/selectors/
